player_intent: Jump to reachable ledges, hang and pull up, climb ladders and hold Jump to slide down.
acceptance_rule: Jump taps and held Jump grab into hang first. Airborne held Jump accepts zero or partial movement input; neutral movement probes along authoritative aim yaw. Ground contact is not required for a reachable airborne grab. Detach cooldown, reach and clearance remain enforced; automatic low vault still requires its existing speed/input thresholds. Release forward then W climbs; S drops; A/D shimmy at saved speed and stop before unsupported edges or blocked space. Jump plus forward also climbs. Pull-up excludes terminal closure and exits once complete. Thin static awnings use top-down face detection. Reach has 1 mm numerical tolerance; slope, support, clearance and opt-out checks remain. Existing ladder controls and serialized traversal context remain intact. CharacterBody alone moves the player.

nodes.role: Consumes movement commands and applies traversal velocities
Authored detection volume and endpoints, never moves player

hang_only_policy: A reachable static hand-grip strip with a clear hang capsule may be accepted even if standing support or overhead pull-up room fails. Store can_pull_up separately. Fresh-W pull-up revalidates the current anchor, foot support, full body sweep and landing capsule. Thin grip-only beams allow safe shimmy/drop but never force a climb. A real wall beneath the grip selects braced presentation; unsupported overhang selects the independently calibrated FreeHang profile. no_climb, unsafe grip, blocked hang, excessive reach and moving surfaces still reject. Narrow standing transitions retain the original full footprint and use the separate narrow_ledge_walk contract.
warehouse_awning_policy: Skip walkable slope hits while looking for a ledge face. If thin/sloped awning horizontal samples miss, search its same-collider top boundary in seven bounded iterations within original reach, then raycast the real fascia. Preserve surface opt-out, reach, five-point support, full-body path and standing capsule checks. Actual container physical jump catches with held Jump or second tap; ground approach remains too low. See docs/WAREHOUSE_AWNING_PROOF.md.
outward_hang_search_policy: If the original hang capsule sweep is blocked, SocomTraversalRuntime.try_begin_automatic_vault searches saved hang_outward_search_m distances, each clamped to 0 through 0.24m, horizontally away from the same surface. Candidates remain within capsule radius plus saved forward reach from the validated anchor. Each candidate must pass the full body sweep and exact destination capsule overlap query. No collision is ignored. The first clear candidate remains hang-first; otherwise only the existing validated walkable-floor fallback may pull up. Jump impulse, gravity, vertical reach, standing support and pull-up clearance are unchanged.

actual_map_proof.selection: Set socom/session/selected_map_document for this test process; use_active_bundle=false alone still inherits user://maps/active_map.json. --user-map explicitly inspects that saved user map without overwriting it.

airborne_short_ledge_policy: If the validated climb path and landing are clear but a downward hang sweep hits walkable floor while airborne, begin the existing pull-up motor instead of rejecting the grab. Shared airborne_floor_blocked_hang_pull_up flag controls this exception. Wall/ceiling hang obstructions still reject. Taller clear hangs remain hang-first. Regression --main uses main.tscn and verifies a physical jump/approach plus overhead rejection. Rendered hand contact is not yet aligned.
visual_check: Inspect dedicated retargeted pull-up, stable hang, safe landing and distance-driven ladder movement/slide. Runtime hip anchoring prevents duplicate body lift. Exact hand-contact polish remains; ladder art and markers must be placed in desired maps.
